scenario: `cooldown 0_s` is legal per LCDB.7.6 (the commitments restatement of LCDB.5.6). Degenerate but not an error — the rate-allow gate emits as usual; the runtime treats a 0-window tracker as always-permitting. Companion to LCDB.5.6.json.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 0_s:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
